Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design and deliver production-grade AI agents https://sierra.ai/blog/meet-the-ai-agent-engineer: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. - Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-development-life-cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

- Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

- Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

- Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalizing product recommendations

- Create generalizable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog https://sierra.ai/blog/five-ways-to-use-ai-agents-financial-services!

- Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

- Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

- Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

For over five decades, the world's most sophisticated institutions have relied on IBISWorld to navigate uncertainty, identify opportunity and stay ahead of change. Banks, consulting firms, governments: when the stakes are high and the answer has to be right, they come to us.
That trust is our legacy, and it's our starting point. We're looking for an experienced payroll professional to own US payroll end to end. You'll be our go-to payroll expert: running accurate payroll across 18 states in ADP Workforce Now, keeping us compliant, and making sure every payroll ties cleanly to the general ledger.
This is a hands-on role with real autonomy. US payroll operations

Accounting and reporting
·Prepare payroll journal entries and accruals for month-end close, and reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts in NetSuite
·Deliver payroll reporting and analysis for Finance, HR and leadership
International payroll support and process improvement
·Provide backup coverage and second-level review for our UK, Germany and Australia payrolls, working with our international payroll specialist and in-country providers
·Document and continuously improve payroll procedures, controls and system configuration, including automation opportunities
·Manage ADP relationship and escalations, and own benefit data flows between ADP and our benefits providers, ensuring elections and deductions stay consistent and reconciled
·Serve as the trusted point of contact for employees, HR and Finance on payroll questions
What You Bring
·5+ years of US multi-state payroll experience, including full ownership of the payroll cycle
·Expert-level ADP Workforce Now (or comparable enterprise payroll platform)
·Deep knowledge of federal and multi-state wage-and-hour an

• Set the product vision, roadmap, and capability priorities for the Chemistry AISF, spanning molecular chemistry and small-molecule synthesis, targeted drug delivery and formulation, colloidal nanochemistry, and the shared analytical backbone.

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

title: Product Development Owner
description:
Product Development Owner
Buffalo Grove, IL
Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 5:00 pm
Remote
Do you want to build software that removes the manual work tax professionals dread every cycle?
CSC Corptax is looking for a Product Owner who pairs strong product fundamentals with a practical, hands-on approach to AI. You will own outcomes for a product area, work with your scrum team inside an agile delivery model, and find ways to eliminate the repetitive data preparation and validation work our clients do today. You will also use AI in your own daily work to move faster from client problem to shipped capability. Some of your work will extend an established product; some will mean shaping a new concept or rethinking an area from the ground up.
If you measure success by client outcomes, like taking apart a messy process to find what can be automated, and see AI as a tool to change how work gets done (not a buzzword), we want to talk with you.
Some of the things that you will be doing?

•
Own outcomes for your product area: Maintain a Now/Next/Later roadmap tied to system year and PI goals. Define success metrics before work starts, commit to “Now” scope you can deliver, and make clear trade-off decisions when priorities change, including when to cut, pivot, or stop work that evidence says will not deliver the outcome.

•
Shape new concepts and rethink existing areas: Take new products, features, and concepts from idea to adoption, and rebuild existing areas when the current approach no longer serves clients. Make scope decisions with incomplete information, adjust requirements as evidence comes in, and say no without stalling the team.

•
Eliminate manual preparation and validation work: Map how clients prepare, reconcile, and validate data today. Identify the repetitive, error-prone steps and design product capabilities (automation, rules-based checks, AI-assisted workflows) that remove them. Quantify the impact in hours saved, errors prevented, and cycle time reduced.

•
Apply AI responsibly in the product: Partner with engineering to identify where AI adds measurable client value. Define the guardrails a regulated tax environment requires: accuracy, auditability, explainability, data security, and clear points for human review. Before AI work starts, set accuracy thresholds, test datasets, and evaluation criteria with engineering so the team knows what “good enough to ship” means.

•
Use AI to work more efficiently: Use AI to draft and refine Features, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and release notes; analyze usage data and client feedback; and explore the codebase to understand current behavior before writing requirements.

•
Run the backlog in an agile framework: Write clear backlog items with testable acceptance criteria in Azure DevOps or Linear. Lead refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, and sprint demos. Identify and manage dependencies across teams.

•
Make insight-driven decisions: Use product analytics, support case trends, and client research to prioritize. Back major roadmap decisions with data, and define and review adoption KPIs within 90 days of each release.

•
Own the client experience end to end: Partner with the escalation owner assigned to your scrum team to understand what clients are reporting about your product, prioritize client issues, and write actionable work items for bugs and enhancements. Validate fixes through user acceptance testing, and apply Corptax UX standards so experiences stay consistent across products.

•
Drive awareness and adoption with go-to-market: Work closely with the go-to-market, Product Marketing, and Marketing teams from concept through launch. Use their view of pipeline strength, demo feedback from sales engineers, and account manager feedback on the product and adoption to shape priorities. Build awareness for new products, features, and concepts, and bring client and market feedback back into the backlog so every release is positioned, adopted, and measured.

• Strong networking fundamentals and an understanding of how attackers move through networks and systems

• Experience investigating real security incidents and taking ownership through to resolution

title: Manufacturing Systems Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE MANUFACTURING TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Scale a manufacturing engine that outgrows the industry's pace. Grow capacity and capability across the full production process, so the team can take on more products and higher volume faster than anyone else builds.

- Build the ecosystem behind gigawatt-scale infrastructure. Build and operate the full manufacturing ecosystem, not just a line, so output compounds as fast as the company scales.

- Be the engine that grows faster than the company itself. Solve problems faster, think bigger, and develop yourself and your team as dynamically as Fluidstack scales around you.

ROLE SCOPE

- Extend NetSuite from finance into the system of record for supply chain and manufacturing: purchasing, inventory, MRP planning, and supplier data.

- Stand up Siemens Teamcenter as our PLM, and build the eBOM to mBOM handoff, engineering change flow, and part master that connect it to the ERP.

- Integrate ERP and PLM with the tools around them: Zip for procurement, MES on the manufacturing floor, and the models that forecast lead times and demand.

- Run data migration and go-live for each system on a timeline set by the build, not by the implementation partner.

- Own every system after launch: keep the data clean, fix what breaks, and ship the next release before the team outgrows the last one.

- You've deployed Siemens Teamcenter or connected a PLM to an ERP, including the BOM handoff and engineering change flow.

Who we are

At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilio ns!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as our next Software Engineer (L2)
Who we are & why we’re hiring
Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.
Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we're on a journey to becoming a globally antiracist company that supports diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business. We employ thousands of Twilio ns worldwide, and we're looking for more builders, creators, and visionaries to help fuel our growth momentum.
About the job
This position is needed to fulfill the critical role of a Software Engineer within Twilio Sendgrid, to be both hands-on in creating, deploying and managing highly available, very large scale distributed systems.
Our systems processed 12 billion emails on Black Friday 2026 and we continue to scale! You will be a key contributor in one or more of these areas - Redesigning backend services to improve scalability, strengthening service security to keep up with changing threats. Delivering solutions that enhance the customer journey and developing new product offerings that provide actionable insights into the health of customers’ email programs.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:

• WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Ship reliable features, at scale, that deliver the most value to your customers. You will partner with engineering and product to understand customers’ challenges, see opportunities, craft solutions, and lead the team to deliver the right value

• BE AN OWNER: Perform thorough and thoughtful code reviews to help maintain a high standard of code quality

• BE AN OWNER: Identify key system metrics and ensure adequate monitoring coverage for new and existing data storage and analytical services

• DRAW THE OWL: Be creative, take your own initiative, and solve some of our most challenging problems
Qualifications
Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications makes for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio . We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
Required:

• 3+ years of experience in your craft with demonstrated skill progression

• Proficiency with Go or similar typed programming languages (Java, C#, C++, Rust, etc)

• Ability to implement reliable, maintainable components

• Automation-minded; experience automating processes and administrative tasks

• A highly effective collaborator, you work with your team and help drive team towards common goals

• Self-driven; take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion

• Degree in Compute

title: Lead RN, Utilization Management
description:
At Clover Health , we are committed to providing high-quality, affordable, and easy-to-understand healthcare plans for America’s seniors. We prioritize preventive care while leveraging data and technology through the Clover Assistant, a powerful tool that helps physicians make informed health recommendations. By giving doctors a holistic view of each member’s complete health history, we ensure better care at a lower cost-delivering the highest value to those who need it most.
The Utilization Management (UM) team plays a vital role in supporting Clover members throughout their care journey. The team is made up of experienced clinicians who combine clinical expertise with data-driven insights to support evidence-based decision-making. Working closely with providers and care partners, the UM team ensures that care transitions are smooth, efficient, and always focused on improving member outcomes while maintaining compliance with CMS guidelines.
As the Lead RN, Utilization Management, you will coach and develop clinical staff, oversee daily review operations, and monitor quality and vendor performance. You will partner with Medical Directors and teams across Clover to strengthen review consistency and improve workflows. The ideal candidate brings sound clinical judgment, strong leadership skills, and a commitment to putting members first.
As a Lead RN, Utilization Management, you will:

• Lead, coach, and onboard Utilization Management nurses and clinical reviewers; use case audits and feedback to support staff development and accountability.

• Manage daily workloads, staffing coverage, and escalations across prospective, concurrent, and retrospective reviews.

• Ensure reviews and determinations are timely, accurate, well documented, and consistent with benefits, clinical criteria, regulatory requirements, and Clover policies.

• Partner with Medical Directors on complex cases, peer-to-peer reviews, and cases requiring physician review.

• Oversee vendor contracting, implementation, performance, and delegation; monitor trends, turnaround times, productivity, and quality, and implement corrective actions.

• Maintain UM policies, procedures, the prior authorization list, and job aids; improve workflows, automation, and the member and provider experience.

• Collaborate with Appeals and Grievances, Care Management, Claims, Provider Relations, Compliance, and Product; support regulatory audits, accreditation, and quality improvement.

Success in this role looks like:

•
You enjoy developing others and helping clinical teams deliver consistent, high-quality work.

•
You use data to improve care operations and turn performance trends into practical solutions.

•
You put members first and bring sound clinical judgment, clear communication, and collaboration to complex decisions.

You should get in touch if:

• You hold an active, unrestricted RN license

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing or equivalent relevant experience.

• You have at least five years of clinical nursing experience and three years in health plan, managed care, or utilization management settings.

• You have experience leading, supervising, or mentoring clinical staff and strong coaching, communication, critical-thinking, and conflict-resolution skills.

• You understand medical-necessity review and clinical documentation, have applied InterQual or MCG criteria, and have working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and applicable CMS requirements.

• You can manage competing priorities and regulatory turnaround times and are proficient with clinical review platforms, electronic health records, and productivity tools.
Preferred:
A multistate or compact RN license; formal people-management experience in a health plan or managed care setting; and experience supporting Medicare Advantage members.
Certification in case management, UM, or healthcare quality; experience with audits, accreditation, delegated vendor oversight, and performance improvement; and familiarity with value

title: Security & Compliance Lead
description:
Lexroom http://Lexroom.ai is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom http://Lexroom.ai.

We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.

Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

 

WHY LEXROOM http://Lexroom.ai?

- Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

- Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.

- Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work-faster, clearer, and more efficiently.

At Lexroom http://Lexroom.ai, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

Role

Law firms and legal teams trust Lexroom with sensitive work, and AI has changed the pace of security: vulnerabilities now surface in hours, not months. We are looking for our first Security & Compliance Lead to build our security function from scratch, owning ISO 27001 compliance and turning vulnerability management into a continuous process. You’ll report to our engineering leadership and work closely with our IT and Infrastructure teams.

Your key responsibilities

- Continuous Vulnerability Management: Build the process to detect, prioritize, and patch vulnerabilities continuously, replacing monthly patch cycles.

- Security Compliance: Own ISO 27001, GDPR, and related security compliance, from policies and controls to documentation and audits.

- Risk Decisions: Decide where to implement controls and where to accept and contain risk, and document the trade-offs clearly.

- Customer Security Requirements: Support our teams in meeting the security and compliance requirements of our customers.

- Building the Function: Set the foundations of security at Lexroom and spread security habits across engineering.

What we’re looking for

- Experience: 5+ years in in security compliance or information security, ideally in a tech company of 200-500 people, or in fintech, payments, or banking.

- ISO 27001 & Compliance: Hands-on experience leading ISO 27001 certifications or audits, with solid knowledge of GDPR.

- Vulnerability Management: A track record of designing or running vulnerability management and patching processes.

- Risk Assessment: Comfort making pragmatic risk trade-offs and explaining them clearly to engineering and leadership.

- Process & Ownership: You build processes that last, and you bring your own view on how security should work in a product company.

- Language: Fluent in English; Italian is a plus.

Rewarding your contribution

- Compensation: €70,000-100,000

- Equity: meaningful equity on top, in line with the seniority of the role

- Team retreats & off-sites: dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas

Benefits That Matter

- Hybrid Work: Hybrid with office presence in our Milan hub.

- Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure peace of mind.

- Meal Vouchers: Daily support to make your lunch breaks easier.

- Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.

At Lexroom http://Lexroom.ai, ambition meets discipline and purpose.

We're not just building a product-we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Success Manager - Cyber (DACH) (m/w/d)
description:
Über Stoïk

Stoïk schützt kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen in Europa vor Cyberrisiken. • Onboarding: Du übernimmst den Onboarding-Prozess für neue Kunden und sorgst für ein nahtloses Erlebnis - je nach Kundengröße im Webinar-Format oder als 1:1-Session. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben im Onboarding-Alltag gehst du dabei mit einer positiven Einstellung an.

• Advanced Support: Gemeinsam mit unserem Cyber-Team leistest du fortgeschrittenen Support zu Cyber-Tools und versicherungstechnischen Voraussetzungen, um das Sicherheitsniveau unserer Kunden spürbar zu erhöhen.

Sales Promotion

• Kunden halten: Du trägst direkt zur Retention-Rate bei Stoïk bei, indem du das Cyber-Präventionsversprechen einlöst, das unser Sales-Team gegeben hat.

• Makler überzeugen: Du schärfst bei Versicherungsmaklern das Bewusstsein dafür, wie wichtig Stoïk Protect für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden ist.

• Cross-Selling erkennen: In den Onboarding-Sessions erkennst du Chancen für unsere Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services und koordinierst das Follow-up eng mit den Cyber- und Sales-Teams.

Projektmanagement

• Prozesse skalieren: Du hilfst dabei, den Onboarding-Prozess stetig zu verbessern, um die Implementierungsrate unserer Cyber-Tools zu steigern. Dem Product-Team lieferst du wertvolles Feedback und konkrete Empfehlungen.

• Schnittstellen nutzen: Du durchdringst unsere Unternehmensstruktur und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams (Cyber, Tech, Product, Marketing) zusammen, um Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und effizient zu lösen.

Das bringst du mit

• Cybersecurity-Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Bereich Cybersicherheit ist bei uns ein absolutes Must-have.

• Kommunikationstalent: Stark in Kommunikation und Präsentation, empathisch im Umgang mit Menschen und erfahren in der Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams.

title: Director of Analytics
description:
About Mass Culture

Mass Culture is a growth media agency. We help mission-driven scale-ups connect brand and performance so they grow faster, more profitably, and with purpose.

About the Role

Mass Culture 's model depends on one discipline: knowing what's actually working, and why. The Director of Analytics owns that discipline agency-wide. You will build the measurement infrastructure, attribution models, and reporting standards that turn campaign data into business decisions, for every client, across every channel.

This is not a dashboarding role. Clients and leadership come to you for the answer behind the numbers: what's driving growth, what's wasting budget, and what to do next. You will set the analytical standard the entire agency works toward, and make sure every team is making decisions on real signals instead of noise.

It is also the role that makes our thesis defensible. We believe brand drives conversion, not the other way around, and we work alongside Brains, a world-class branding agency. Believing that is easy. Proving it is your job. Incrementality tests, geo experiments, holdouts, and media mix modeling are how brand investment earns its budget instead of asking for it on faith.

Responsibilities

Measurement Strategy & Infrastructure

• Own agency-wide measurement architecture: attribution models, incrementality testing frameworks, and reporting standards used across every client account.

• Build the tracking, tagging, and data infrastructure that makes cross-channel measurement reliable, and audit it regularly for gaps.
●Own the metric dictionary: one documented definition for every metric we report, with its source, its owner, and its known caveats.
●Define what measurement maturity looks like at each stage of a client relationship, and move every account up that ladder deliberately.

• Set the standard for what good measurement looks like at Mass Culture , and hold every team accountable to it.

Data Narrative & Decision Quality

• Own the standing narrative for each account: one continuous arc of what we believed, what we tested, what we learned, and what changed.

• Hold every number we ship to one standard: what happened, why, what it means for the business, what we are doing about it, and what we need from the client.

• State confidence explicitly. Separate signal from noise, and say plainly when a movement is not yet a result.

• Name what would have to be true for a recommendation to be wrong, and what evidence would change our mind. We kill our own conclusions before a client has to.

• Make findings survive translation. The same insight has to hold up for a channel specialist, an account strategist, and a founder or CFO, without quietly changing meaning on the way up.

• Guard the line between narrative and spin. A good story that runs ahead of the evidence is a failure of this role, not a win.

• Set and teach the house standard for how Mass Culture writes about data, and coach analysts and strategists to write to it.

Insight & Business Impact

• Proactively turn raw performance data into clear, decision-ready insight: what's driving revenue and margin, what's not working, and what to test next.

• Partner with Account Strategists and media channel leads to connect channel-level data to client business outcomes.

• Lead the analytical narrative in QBRs and strategic reviews, presenting findings directly to senior client stakeholders.

• Contribute measurement expertise to new business pitches and client onboarding.

Testing & Experimentation

• Partner with strategy to design and run incrementality tests, holdout studies, geo experiments, and media mix experiments that validate, or kill, strategic assumptions.

• Build and maintain a multi-year learning agenda per account: a testing roadmap tied to the business questions that actually matter, not a backlog of curiosities.

description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack - energy, data centers, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services - delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.
At Nscale , our Controls & Networks team sets the standards that keep every facility in our fleet monitored, controlled, and reliable, from the device layer to the operator's screen. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscale r, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
About the Role
As Controls Director, you will be the functional authority for controls engineering across Nscale 's data center fleet. You'll own the standards for BMS/BAS and EPMS, steward our SCADA and HMI platforms, set the rules for alarm and telemetry consistency, lead commissioning discipline, and drive our Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DMfA) program.
Our controls strategy rests on one principle: structured diversity at the device layer, and uncompromising consistency at the HMI, SCADA, alarm, and telemetry layers. Your job is to turn that principle into enforceable standards and acceptance criteria, and to build the specialist team that verifies them on every site.
This is a standards-and-governance leadership role. Regional Project Directors deliver projects; you decide what good looks like and develop the people who check it. You'll report to the VP, Controls & Networks, and lead a directorate that brings together SCADA and controls SMEs, MEP specialists, Commissioning Managers, and engineering staff. The role covers the Americas, with travel across regions as required.
Your directorate works alongside, not over, Nscale 's Design teams, who hold architectural, mechanical, and base-build design authority; your SMEs are embedded with them as standing reviewers. DC Operations handles day-to-day maintenance of operating controls, and Systems Engineering owns tools and data once data leaves the site.
What You'll be Doing
Standards and Platform Authority

• Own the controls standards library: control narratives and sequences, alarm management (ISA-18.2), high-performance HMI (ISA-101), master points lists, and telemetry and MQTT/Sparkplug B conventions.

• Own the Skid-to-Master Interface Specification and make it a mandatory exhibit on packaged-equipment purchase orders.

• Steward the SCADA platform portfolio, including Ignition as our delivery basis, and lead platform evolution through a gated qualification program while incumbent platforms remain supported.

• Rule on controls standards deviations through a formal review process, ensuring no deviation reaches field execution without a decision or escalation.

Change Management and Operations Support

• Hold management of change (MOC) approval for changes to operating controls and BMS systems.

• Own patch testing for controls scope, keeping development and production strictly separated, and manage implementation in partnership with the CISO organization.

Commissioning and Readiness

• Lead the Commissioning Managers and the commissioning discipline, including Cx strategy for each project, FAT/CAT/SAT governance, and the site integration readiness gate.

• Protect independence between commissioning and acceptance, so no system is accepted solely by the team that commissioned it.

Design for Manufacture and Assembly

• Drive a governed control-panel catalog, build-to-print construction packages, and fabricator skid-PLC integration under Master PLCs.

• Shape and grow the DMfA fun
